Synopsis:
A dialogue with Hope - in person, not with the spirit form.First greeting is after players free her - she will start following the player after that as well.Later, after defeating Raphael, players can talk to Hope, ask who she is, why she was trapped and how's she connected to Raphael.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_HouseOfHope_Hope.json: Off-screen the party has already freed Hope in person (she is not a spirit) and she has begun following the player. The immediate moment comes after the party’s victory over Raphael, so Raphael’s defeat and Hope’s rescue are recent and relevant to the lines. Hope is shaken and euphoric—alternating fear that this is still a dream with exuberant relief—and repeatedly mentions “my beautiful sister,” who fought the party but survived despite being badly hurt. The player can now ask who Hope is, why she was imprisoned, and how she was connected to Raphael; her dialogue reflects trauma, gratitude, and complicated feelings toward her sister and her captors.
- LOW_HouseOfHope_HopeSpirit01.json: First dialogue with Hope's spirit that happens after players get to House of Hope.Hope is a captive within the House, and has been driven mad by years of psychological and physical torture. Raphael keeps her alive because she astonishes him - and the reason for that is that no matter what he does to her, she holds onto the last of her hope and optimism. That fascinates him.In this dialogue, Hope introduces players to the House of Hope. They have arrived here deliberately, knowing that they are not invited, and that it is likely dangerous.Hope appears to warn them of that danger, and to help them, and also introduces the deranged vibe of the area.Note: When Hope speaks in all-caps, she is showing the manic side of her personality. Louder, more intense, and almost like she's possessed by a different, more deranged version of herself.
- LOW_HouseOfHope_AD_HopeSaved.json: Hope is grateful for saving her, and she's readying to join players
- LOW_HouseOfHope_RaphaelAppearance.json: Dialogue with Raphael in House of Hope, when players try to escape it after an alarm goes off
- LOW_HouseOfHope_AD_HopeCallsToTalk.json: While players are exploring House of Hope, Hope can appear to tell about the rooms. She will call, so player would paid attention to her

context: The party has just freed Hope in person and defeated Raphael; she has begun following the player and this conversation happens immediately after those events. Hope is shaken and euphoric—oscillating between terrified, manic insistence that this might still be a dream and exuberant relief—and repeatedly praises “my beautiful sister,” who fought the party and survived but is badly hurt. Off-screen, Hope was kept captive and subjected to prolonged psychological and physical torment; Raphael kept her alive because her stubborn optimism fascinated him. The player can now ask who she is, why she was imprisoned, and how she’s connected to Raphael; her replies will mix trauma, gratitude, and complicated feelings toward both her sister and her captors.
